task: Stream public audit HTML into bounded extraction, preserve safe evidence on limits, and test larger pages on Workers Free.
nonGoals: Paid resources, rollout to existing production or preview services, rubric weight changes, new public audit features, or weakened retrieval protections.

outcomes.description: The live audit consumes HTML as a bounded stream and can extract evidence beyond the former 512 KiB ceiling.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen complete, late-evidence, exactly-at-cap, over-cap, and timeout cases.

outcomes.description: A bounded prefix yields incomplete findings without final score or unsupported absence, uniqueness, or fix claims.
outcomes.evidence: Scoring and service regression tests on complete and limited input.

outcomes.description: The reviewed pipeline runs on Cloudflare Workers Free for fixed over-512 KiB and truncated workloads.
outcomes.evidence: Dedicated finite, authenticated synthetic probe, measured CPU when observable, and cleanup record.

process.description: Use Terra implementers and independent review, retain actual offline evaluation and hosted CI, and keep the live probe separate and isolated.
process.evidence: Git history, trace, hosted CI and sanitized observed runtime results.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse current extractor, retrieval guards and report types. Bound work and retained evidence without new dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Retrieval and scoring behavior change without changes to agent workflow, handoff, portability or resumability.
